gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent, locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor cancer excluding the following: MSI-low colorectal cancer, glioblastoma multiforme, prostate cancer, pancreatic cancer, mucosal and ocular melanoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] CDX-527: Dose-escalation phase: Eligible patients will receive CDX-527 treatment based on cohort assigned until progression or intolerance.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Receipt of all standard therapies for the tumor type

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic Evaluation: CDX-527 serum concentrations will be measured at specified visits.

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] CDX-527: CDX-527 is administered by infusion every 2 weeks

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational PD-L1 x CD27 bispecific antibody

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket in which glioblastoma multiforme is explicitly excluded (gbm_excluded); basket coded true for the multi-cancer design. Treatment setting: recurrent/advanced after all standard therapies. Pre- and on-treatment biopsies 'if required' are mentioned but no pharmacodynamic objective is stated; PK is serum only. MSI-H applies only to the colorectal cancer subgroup (MSI-low colorectal excluded); coded as eligibility for that tumour type, not linked to the candidate in the record.
